description.en: Explore any topic through direct AI answers, interactive paths, surprising facts, and favorites.
description.zh: 输入任何主题，通过 AI 直接答案、探索分支、趣味知识和收藏继续发现。

releaseNotes.en: Redesigns Discover as a focused question feed, sharpens topics around concrete tensions and surprising explanations, and refreshes content every 30 minutes.
releaseNotes.zh: 将探索页重做为问题信息流，让话题围绕具体矛盾和意外解释展开，并改为每半小时更新。
